notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! I’ve got a fresh batch of updates to share with you regarding the [b]Body Sushi[/b] demo and future plans.[/p][h2]✨ Demo Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Character Arts Refined[/b] – In-game character arts have been updated to better reflect each character’s traits and personality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Toro Nigiri Bug Fixed[/b] – You can now unlock Toro Nigiri as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved UX[/b] – Kitchen and Nyotaimori interfaces are now [b]minimizable[/b], making it easier to navigate. This also resolves the issue where the Settings interface could be blocked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Demo Shop Updated[/b] – Items now display affordability based on how much money you have. Please note that in the demo, the Store itself will remain non-functional, so purchases won’t be possible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Enhancements[/b] – Added some post-processing effects to make the game look sharper and more vibrant.[/p][/*][/list][h2]📌 Development Notes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Demo Scope Finalized[/b] – The demo will no longer expand further. This ensures I can focus fully on adding content for the [b]official release planned for December[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Character in Progress[/b] – I’m currently working on a new character: [b]Arisa[/b], a cheerful blonde addition to the cast! Here’s a little teaser:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446013/6820655e50bc91f8e338db4a988a06f2011661fc.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2]❤️ Thank You[/h2][p]Thank you all for your continued support, feedback, and wishlists—it means the world and keeps development moving strong. Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to release![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Demo Update

notes.title: ✨ Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! We’ve got a fresh update for the [b]Body Sushi[/b] demo with some exciting improvements and important fixes. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][b]✅ New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Added Heart-Shaped Pattern:[/b] Show your love with the new heart-shaped sushi arrangement![/p][/*][*][p][b]Nyotaimori Collision SFX:[/b] We’ve added sound effects when placing sushi on the body for a more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tip Calculation Update:[/b] Tips are now based on your [b]pattern placement completion[/b]—the more precise, the better the reward![/p][/*][*][p][b]Pattern Placement Expansion:[/b] We’ve introduced a new pattern system, starting with the heart shape, and more patterns are coming soon![/p][/*][/list][p][b]🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Yummy Appearance Bug:[/b] Yummy will no longer appear before the tutorial ends to prevent conversation flow issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wall Issues Fixed:[/b] No more invisible holes lurking in the walls![/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting & Shadows:[/b] Adjusted for a smoother, more polished look.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for all the feedback and support—keep it coming! notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello Chefs! 🍣[/p][p]We’ve just rolled out a small patch to address some pesky issues that were getting in the way of your perfect sushi-making experience. Here’s what’s been fixed:[/p][h3]✅ [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Kitchen Scene Issue:[/b] Fixed a bug where grabbing ingredients [i]not[/i] part of the current nigiri recipe caused the player to lose interaction with all objects in the scene, forcing a restart from the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kuroneko Appearance:[/b] Resolved an issue where the humanoid Kuroneko character was not properly showing up in the restaurant.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Plating Behavior:[/b] Fixed a bug where Kuroneko, as the plating character, could not respond to sushi placements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wardrobe Animation:[/b] Corrected an issue where Kuroneko lost her animations in the Wardrobe UI.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for reporting these bugs and helping us improve the experience! More updates and content are on the way, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Sushi Masters! 🍣✨[/p][p]We’ve just released a [b]huge update[/b] to the [i]Body Sushi[/i] demo — and it’s packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes driven by your feedback. Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][h3]🆕 [b]Placement System V2: Total Control, Better Flow[/b][/h3][p]We’ve completely redesigned the sushi placement system to give you smoother, smarter control:[/p][p]🔲 [b]Grid-Based Precision[/b]
Each placement now snaps to a [b]clear grid[/b], giving you total control over where each sushi piece lands.[/p][p]👁️ [b]Live Placement Preview[/b]
Hover before you place — you’ll see exactly how the sushi will land. No more guesswork![/p][p]⏱️ [b]No More Time Pressure[/b]
We’ve [b]removed the placement time constraint[/b] — so now you can focus on creativity without racing the clock.[/p][p]⚡ [b]Smoother, More Responsive Controls[/b]
It just [i]feels[/i] better. Try it and see![/p][p][/p][h3]🍱 [b]Other Major Updates[/b][/h3][p]✔️ [b]Cutting Board Flow Streamlined[/b]
You no longer need to manually pick up and drop off sushi from the cutting board to the tray. After cutting, your pieces go [b]straight into your sushi inventory[/b] — simple and efficient.[/p][p]📦 [b]Inventory Interface Added[/b]
We've added a [b]clear sushi inventory UI[/b], so you can always see how many sushi pieces you’ve prepped and what’s available to serve.[/p][p]🐛 [b]Bugfix: Nigiri Can’t Be Cut Anymore[/b]
Because come on — who slices a Nigiri? This pesky bug is squashed.[/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Try It Now – And Tell Us What You Think![/h3][p]If you’ve already played the demo, now’s the perfect time to hop back in and feel the difference. If this is your first time — welcome to [i]Body Sushi[/i]! Your journey begins now.[/p][quote][p]💬 We [i]love[/i] hearing from you. Share your thoughts, feedback, and reactions on the \[Steam Community page] or in our Discord. Your feedback fuels our updates![/p][/quote][p]Thank you for supporting [i]Body Sushi[/i] — this is only the beginning![/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update
notes.notes:
[h2]🐾 New Unlockable Character: [b]Kuroneko[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Kuroneko is drawn to the leftover sashimi in your kitchen — so go ahead and make a mess!
[*] She’s hiding somewhere in the restaurant (as all cats love to do). Find her and discover what she’s up to!
[*] Once recruited, you can set her as your favorite character using the Wardrobe interface (click the button in the top right corner).
[/list]

[h2]🎮 New Playable Game Loop[/h2]
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial story, you can now start a new business day by visiting the front desk.
[*] Added a Daily Summary interface to track your progress.
[*] Introduced the Wardrobe interface for selecting your favorite character.
[*] Working alongside your favorite character now increases her affinity with you.
[*] Tip distribution now affects the devotion level of your favorite character.
[/list]

[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a missing arrow in the Settings interface.
[*] Resolved an issue where Nyotaimori was presented twice when time expired.
[*] The Nyotaimori scene now clears properly after completion.
[*] Improved the drop indicators for better clarity and projection.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Update
notes.notes:
Big improvements and tasty new features are on the menu! 🍣 Let’s dig in:

[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🕹️ [b]WASD movement[/b] is now enabled — and yes, [b]Space Bar[/b] too!  
[*] 🚪 You now begin each day [b]at the entrance[/b] of the restaurant for a smoother start.  
[*] 🖱️ Objects now follow the cursor much more smoothly when held.
[/list]

[h3] 🍱 Interactions & Story[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🧩 Some scene objects are now [b]interactable[/b]! (More to come in future updates 👀)  
[*] 💁‍♀️ You can now [b]tip Yummy[/b] at the end of the demo for her excellent service — don’t disappoint her! 💸  
[*] ⏱️ If [b]time runs out[/b] during nyotaimori plating, you'll now be forced to present your creation anyway. No hiding!  
[*] 📖 Added more detailed scenes for the currently available story content.
[/list]

[h3]🧱 Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🧱 Fixed some misaligned walls in the restaurant.
[/list]

---

Thanks for playing and supporting the game! More juicy updates are on the way soon! 🍣✨

notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
[h2]🍣 Body Sushi Demo is LIVE! 🍣[/h2]

Hey everyone!
The wait is over — Body Sushi Demo is finally here!

Get ready to dive into the delicious chaos of our unique sushi restaurant experience, where bold flavors meet unexpected twists. This is just the beginning, and we can't wait to hear what you think!

🎮 Try it now, share your feedback, and help us roll this game into something truly unforgettable!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated localization for all supported languages
[*] Improved click interactions when picking up or dropping any objects
[*] All click interactions are now left clicks only
[*] No longer requires C key to cut sushi rolls into smaller pieces
[*] Improved object interactions when dropping objects - Objects no longer fly away
[/list]
